choice_data_list: Then I'll get it and keep it safe for you

text_block_list.text:
To hold it in my own hands in order to 
protect it... Indeed, that is one way of 
looking at it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer-dono. I pray for your 
success...!

text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
